prompt: This `aspace_destroy` frees the right number of frames for a process, but the first interrupt after destroying any process crashes the machine. Tap the faulty line.
explain: PML4 entry 0 is the kernel's mapping, copied into every address space and pointing at the same shared tables. Starting the walk at 0 frees the kernel's own page tables, so every remaining address space (including the kernel's) loses its kernel mappings. The walk must start at entry 1.
